description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrades for Linksys devices, including retrieving the target firmware partition, handling upgrade procedures, and associated low-level NAND operations.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition by querying the boot environment and system files, returning 'kernel1' or 'kernel2' accordingly.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process for Linksys devices, handling partition selection, UBI volume management, and executing the actual NAND update.
